symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: In the incident window payment-service calls to gateway-mock /authorize were answered with HTTP 429 TooManyRequests (6 requests), so 6 orders moved to PAYMENT_FAILED. No restarts or errors in the services; latency on gateway-mock /authorize was low.

evidence.why: Gateway-mock answered payment-service with 429 TooManyRequests in the incident window and not before.
payment-service logged the gateway answering 429 for order b5c18dea, with no latency on the answer.
The order trace shows the payment attempt FAILED after the payment-service call, ending the order in PAYMENT_FAILED.
Runbook states gateway-mock normally answers at once with AUTHORIZED, so a 429 is an abnormal rejection by gateway-mock.
